svg.title: pinright architecture
svg.desc: The coding agent calls MCP tools or triggers the pre-install hook. Both use the verdict pipeline (deps.dev, OSV, registries, offline lookalike list); the MCP tools also use the docs pipeline (package files at the version, repo at the release tag via jsDelivr, llms.txt, site discovery). The answer goes back fenced: a security notice, docs inside untrusted-data blocks, or a deny, ask or allow decision.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two entry points (MCP tools the agent calls, a hook that runs before each command or write) feed one verdict pipeline and one docs pipeline.

svg.text: Public services only: deps.dev, OSV, the package registries, jsDelivr, GitHub, and the docs site a package’s metadata names. No telemetry, no account.
